title: A pool with a free list inside
hints: Fill the free list by pushing the blocks from the **last** to the first; since the list is last-in first-out, that makes the first block the head.

Pushing a block writes the current head into the block's first 8 bytes and makes the block the new head. Popping reads those 8 bytes back into the head. `std::memcpy` both ways avoids any pointer casts.
